implementation.behavior: DRW_DbColor::encodeDwg stages body, string and handle destinations and publishes only after all writes succeed. It preserves legacy inline strings, AC1018 and later handle routing, and shared string/handle stream aliasing. Allocation failure returns false without changing caller streams; retrying the same record succeeds.

limitations: Generated transaction controls establish failure rollback only for the tested AC1018/AC1021 color profile and stream layouts.
This does not add DBCOLOR fields, physical producer qualification, native acceptance, graph closure, or support promotion.
The allocation sweep compares retry output with clean encoded output; separate existing parser vectors cover codec readback.
